name: Lesson 7 · Verbs that change their vowel: fahren, essen, lesen, sehen…

cards.note: Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. ich keeps the vowel of the infinitive: fahre. Auto fahren, with no article, means to drive.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. fahren adds an umlaut in the du form: a becomes ä.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. The er form changes too: fährt. Only du and er/sie/es change.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. A train fährt: fahren is any travel by vehicle, including the vehicle itself.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. ihr keeps the plain vowel: fahrt, no umlaut.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. der Bus → fährt, with the umlaut.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. ich esse: no change in the ich form.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. essen changes e to i: du isst. The stem ends in s, so only -t is added.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. er isst: the same form as du.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. isst du: the changed vowel stays when the verb moves to the front.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. wir essen: wir never changes the vowel.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. ihr esst: the plain e, and just -t after the s.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. lesen changes e to ie: sie liest.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. du liest: the stem ends in s, so the s of -st is swallowed.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. ich lese: no change.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. er liest, with ie.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. sehen changes e to ie: er sieht. einen Film: the object.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. du siehst. German uses the plain verb where English adds can.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. wir sehen: no change.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. ihr seht: no change for ihr.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. Ordering food, German says I take: ich nehme.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. nehmen changes more than its vowel: du nimmst, with mm and no h.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. sie nimmt: i, a double m, no h.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. nimmst du: asking about coffee, nehmen means to take.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. sprechen changes e to i: du sprichst.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. sie spricht: e becomes i. Languages take no article.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. ich spreche: no change.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. wir sprechen: no change.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. schlafen adds an umlaut: es schläft.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. du schläfst: a becomes ä.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. er schläft. lange schlafen: to sleep for a long time, to sleep in.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. wir schlafen: no umlaut.

cards.front: You **give** the money, and I buy the bread. (one friend)
cards.back: Du **gibst** das Geld, und ich kaufe das Brot.
cards.note: Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. geben changes e to i: du gibst.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. wer takes the er form: gibt.

cards.front: Today the woman **is watching** a film.
cards.note: Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. The changed vowel stays wherever the verb stands: heute sieht die Frau.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. er isst; der Fisch → keinen Fisch as the object.
Stem-changing verbs: du and er change the vowel. er liest, second after warum.
